clause: Character controls panel + full attribute set [STU-TYP-012]

scope.summary: Store character attributes per contiguous character range on StudioTextStory; mixed values across a selection are representable and reported as mixed. Implement the normative control set: font family+style, size (points; Figma dip accepted at decode), leading (absolute or auto-leading %), tracking (1/1000 em, may be negative), kerning (metrics/optical/manual — see MT-205), horizontal/vertical scale, baseline shift, character rotation, case (all-caps/small-caps/title/lower, non-destructive), position (super/subscript synthesized), decoration (underline solid/dotted/wavy + strikethrough — see MT-207), faux bold/italic, per-range language, no-break, fractional widths, vertical trim (leading-trim), anti-alias method, fill/stroke color as StudioColorProfile-tagged/StudioSwatch ref (see MT-204/14.8) incl. partial-selection coloring, and per-range hyperlink (URL or in-document StudioArtboard/StudioPageSpread target). Character panel operator surface + model command.
acceptance_criteria: full character attribute set per-range with mixed reporting; character panel + model command; all listed controls present
expected_tests: live: each attribute applies per-range; mixed-selection reported as mixed
argus: character panel exposes full attribute set with stable author_ids

risk_if_missed: No character formatting; core typography unusable.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
